xit-roundup.credit_line: "The old XIT round-up outfit on the move, 4.30 a.m." - a later Montana round-up, not the winter of 1886-87: the XIT did not put cattle on its Montana range until 1889, and the print is dated no later than 1912. Photograph by L. A. Huffman. Theodore Roosevelt Collection, Houghton Library, Harvard University.

cattle-blizzard.description: Cattle in a blizzard on the plains / drawn by Charles Graham from a sketch H. Worrall. 1 print : wood engraving. Illus. in: Harper's Weekly, 1886 Feb. 27, p. 132. Cropped from the LOC copy negative to the printed plate and its caption.
cattle-blizzard.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
cattle-blizzard.credit_line: Cattle in a Blizzard on the Plains - wood engraving by Charles Graham after a sketch by H. Worrall, published in Harper's Weekly, February 27, 1886. It is a picture of an earlier storm, printed a year before the winter of 1886-87. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
